tracks.narration: Two address bits, four output lines — and only one of them fires at a time.
The truth table lays it out — for each of the four input combinations, exactly one output is high and the other three stay low.
Inside, four AND gates each watch for one input pattern — the inputs and their inverses are routed so each gate fires for one and only one combination.
Step the inputs through all four patterns — and watch the high output hop down the column, one at a time.
Two bits give four addresses — and a decoder turns each address into a single chosen line.
